## Release identity

This release uses `v0.0.1-beta.12` across the CLI, web workspace, Flutter source package, Android artifacts, and GitHub Release assets.

## Mobile builds

- Android package: `com.anytty.app`, version name `0.0.1-beta.12`, version code `17`.
- iOS App Store build: marketing version `1.1.0`, build `17`. App Store Connect already has version `1.1.0`, so this build is the store-compatible representation of the `v0.0.1-beta.12` release identity.
- Android APKs and the Play AAB are signed by the persistent Android upload key in CI.

## Changes

- Prevented normal Android terminal input from opening the Oppo/ColorOS secure keyboard.
- Kept the browser and remote terminal features from the previous beta release.
